note: Setup rating overrides, read by prefill/assemble.mjs. By default a project is 'Easy setup' when it is an app (install like a normal app or use in a browser) and 'Advanced setup' when it is server software, a developer tool or a code library. 'easy' lists self-run or developer projects that have an official free hosted version or are simply a website (only official, free ones; one reason each). 'advanced' lists apps that still take real effort to set up. Reasons are shown on the project page.

easy.cryptpad: The CryptPad project runs a free public site, cryptpad.fr, so you can use it in a browser with no setup.
easy.mastodon: The Mastodon project runs a free official server, mastodon.social, that anyone can sign up to.
easy.pixelfed: Pixelfed's creator runs a free public site, pixelfed.social, that anyone can join.
easy.lemmy: The Lemmy project runs a free public site, lemmy.ml, that anyone can join.
easy.misskey: Misskey's makers run a free public site, misskey.io, that anyone can join.
easy.piefed: The PieFed project runs a free public site, piefed.social, that anyone can join.
easy.writefreely: Its makers run write.as, which has a free plan, so you can start writing in a browser.
easy.zulip: Zulip runs a free hosted version (Zulip Cloud Free) at zulipchat.com.
easy.wordpress: WordPress.com is the official hosted version and has a free plan.
easy.grist: Its makers run a hosted version at getgrist.com with a free plan.
easy.baserow: Its makers run a hosted version at baserow.io with a free plan.
easy.cal-com: Its makers run a hosted version at cal.com with a free plan.
easy.documenso: Its makers run a hosted version at documenso.com with a free plan.
easy.formbricks: Its makers run a hosted version at formbricks.com with a free plan.
easy.umami: Its makers run Umami Cloud, which has a free plan.
easy.posthog: Its makers run PostHog Cloud, which has a free plan.
easy.grafana: Its makers run Grafana Cloud, which has a free plan.
easy.plane: Its makers run a hosted version at plane.so with a free plan.
easy.dub: Its makers run a hosted version at dub.co with a free plan.
easy.kutt: Its makers run a hosted version at kutt.it that you can use for free.
easy.ntfy: Its maker runs a free public server, ntfy.sh, and there are phone apps, so you don't need your own server.
easy.librespeed: The project runs a public speed test site, librespeed.org, that works in a browser.
easy.stirling-pdf: It has desktop installers for Windows, Mac and Linux, and an official free hosted version at stirlingpdf.io.
easy.gitlab: GitLab runs gitlab.com, an official hosted version with a free plan.
easy.forgejo: Codeberg.org is a free public site that runs Forgejo, so you can use it without your own server.
easy.openstreetmap: It is a website: you use it at openstreetmap.org in a browser.
easy.open-library: It is a website: you use it at openlibrary.org in a browser.
easy.onlyoffice-docs: ONLYOFFICE makes a free desktop app (ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors) for Windows, Mac and Linux that you install like any other program; only the shared online editor needs a server.
